title: Lightborn Inheritance Revelation
subtitle: Uncover your true pre-Collapse royal bloodline
loreBackground: Ancient encrypted records (.arch) in the Central Library suggest that your signal signature matches the lost Seraphima bloodline from the Purge era. Unsealing these files reveals forbidden historical truths about the AETHERCORE.

steps.text: Locate Purge_Era_Genealogy.arch in Central Library archives
Acquire Lineage Key 'lightborn' or reach Cryptography Lv 2
Decrypt encrypted lineage file in Document Modal or AureScanner

dialogueHooks.briefing: Aelita: 'Your signal feels... unusual. There are pre-Collapse genealogical files locked under heavy ciphers.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Search the library archives for .arch files containing Seraphima lineage markers.
dialogueHooks.completion: Lineage verified: You hold inherited resonance clearance for AETHERCORE subterranean conduits!

title: Aureline Faction Supremacy
subtitle: Forge bonds and align with Aureline's major power centers
loreBackground: Power in Aureline is divided between the Digital Governance Agency (DGA), Cycademy of Sciences, and the VectorNet underground. Navigating faction relations shapes world events and grants exclusive access.

steps.text: Complete DGA Civic Onboarding registration
Reach 70 Trust with Jeremie (VectorNet) and 80 Trust with Dr. Voss (FaithMed)
Declare house tag affiliation in Pulse Network

dialogueHooks.briefing: DGA Notice: 'Citizens who maintain strong faction standings receive priority clearance and resource stipends.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Increase friendship and trust vectors with key faction representatives in Comms.
dialogueHooks.completion: Faction Envoy status recognized across all Aureline municipal districts.

title: Master Protocol Weaving
subtitle: Master cyber-magic crafting in the SpellForge Matrix
loreBackground: By combining elemental logic blocks (.mod) in SpellForge, weavers craft compiled reality protocols (.spell) capable of stabilizing data bleeds, dispelling PRISM malware, and boosting aura shields.

steps.text: Combine Firewall.mod and Compression.mod in SpellForge
Compile 3 custom protocol spells
Reach Spellcasting Level 3

dialogueHooks.briefing: Hex: 'Code and magic are two sides of the same frequency coin. Forge your first protocol spell.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Collect .mod files from File Explorer and drag them into the SpellForge canvas.
dialogueHooks.completion: Master Protocol Weaver title bestowed. Advanced spell block recipes unlocked!

title: Founding Day Protocol
subtitle: Annual March 6 festival & secret archive unveiling
prerequisite: Month of March / Active World Event
loreBackground: During the Founding Day festival, historical vaults are temporarily unsealed. Uncover royal coronation logs, hidden AETHERCORE subterranean conduits, and rare ceremonial credits.

steps.text: Access records.orynvell.gov during Founding Day
Inspect Deed Record #DEED-99401 for Subterranean Conduit Sector 7
Claim Founding Day ceremonial credit stipend

dialogueHooks.briefing: Broadcast: 'Founding Day is live! Public records vault is open for citizen inspection.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Open Browser and navigate to records.orynvell.gov to claim archives.
dialogueHooks.completion: Founding Day archives secured! Claimed 500 ₡ bonus.

title: Aura Flux Outbreak Containment
subtitle: Emergency triage during dimensional energy spike
loreBackground: A sudden Veil-thinning event causes student aura corruption across Cycademy dorms. Faith Medical requires emergency diagnostic scans (.diag) to triage patients and stabilize the contagion.

steps.text: Open faithmed.aure and execute telemetry diagnostic scan
Purge Veilwilt & Sunspire Burn Fever conditions
Review Patient Log #FM-88392 for recovery telemetry

dialogueHooks.briefing: Dr. Sharon: 'Aura flux is spiking in Sector 3! We need immediate telemetry scans from all active citizens.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Run intake diagnostic scan at faithmed.aure to restore Aura Integrity.
dialogueHooks.completion: Outbreak contained! Aura Integrity restored to 100%.

title: Day 1: Boot Sequence
subtitle: Initial OS login and desktop orientation
loreBackground: Log in to MIRAVERSEOSX for the first time. Familiarize yourself with the taskbar, header status, credit ledger, and core workspace applications.

steps.text: Boot up MIRAVERSEOSX desktop environment
Open File Explorer and view starter directories

dialogueHooks.briefing: System: 'Welcome to MIRAVERSEOSX v4.2. Desktop initialization complete.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Explore your desktop applications and system taskbar.
dialogueHooks.completion: Boot sequence completed! Earned starter credits.

title: Day 1: DGA & Faith Medical Emails
subtitle: Review official onboarding dispatches in Mail
loreBackground: Read mandatory civic dispatches sent by the Department of Governance Affairs and Faith Medical Group outlining identity verification and aura compliance.

steps.text: Open Civic Mailbox / AureMail
Read DGA Civic Onboarding dispatch
Read Faith Medical Pre-Registration email

dialogueHooks.briefing: Dispatch: 'Attention Citizen: Check your inbox for required registration packets.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Open Mail and review emails from DGA and Faith Medical.
dialogueHooks.completion: Onboarding packets reviewed. Citizen Record app unlocked for biometrics!

title: Day 1: Identity Registration
subtitle: Complete Fingerprint, Facial, & Aura scans
loreBackground: Launch Citizen Record app (passport) to complete your biometric registration. Scan fingerprint, capture facial geometry, and generate your official Citizen ID and Barcode.

steps.text: Launch Citizen Record (passport) app
Complete Fingerprint & Facial biometric capture
Generate official Citizen ID and Barcode

dialogueHooks.briefing: DGA Directive 14-B: 'Biometric registration is mandatory for all active citizens.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Complete biometric captures inside Citizen Record app.
dialogueHooks.completion: Identity verified! Pulse Social Network app unlocked.

title: Day 1: Pulse Profile Activation
subtitle: Create your handle & view NPC messages
loreBackground: Set up your public handle, house tag affiliation, and visibility settings on the Pulse social network to receive incoming broadcasts from Jeremie, Aelita, and Odd.

steps.text: Create Pulse profile handle and house tag
View incoming Pulse messages from Jeremie & Aelita

dialogueHooks.briefing: Jeremie: 'Saw your profile go live on Pulse. Welcome to the network.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Configure your Pulse handle and read initial posts.
dialogueHooks.completion: Pulse profile active! Comms Portal unlocked.

title: First Orynvell Bank Audit
subtitle: Authenticate PIN #0994 & trace wire transfer
loreBackground: Leaked dispatches in AureMail mention a secret 50,000 ₡ wire transfer routed through vector account #0994-AURA. Unlock First Orynvell Bank with PIN 0994 to trace the funds.

steps.text: Open bank.aure in Net Browser
Authenticate vault with security PIN #0994
Execute wire audit trace for +300 ₡ bounty

dialogueHooks.briefing: Zero Cool: 'Did you verify the wire transfer at First Orynvell Bank? Use PIN 0994.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Log in to bank.aure and run the suspect wire transfer audit.
dialogueHooks.completion: Wire transfer audit complete! 300 ₡ bounty deposited.

title: Format Bad Sector Clusters
subtitle: Clean storage blocks in terminal undervault
loreBackground: Execute terminal commands or SQL queries to format 5 corrupted sector blocks in the Undervault storage system.

steps.text: Launch Terminal app
Execute command: format /sector:5 /clean

dialogueHooks.briefing: Notice: '5 bad sector clusters reported in Undervault storage.'

title: AureScanner Asset Diagnostic
subtitle: Scan downloaded files for trackers & malware
loreBackground: Use AureScanner in AureSuite to scan asset files (e.g. SUSPECT_MANIFEST_CG8821.exe) for viruses and tracking malware.

steps.text: Navigate to auresuite.aure in Browser and open AureScanner
Run security diagnostic scan on downloaded files

dialogueHooks.briefing: AureScanner Alert: 'Unverified downloaded assets require diagnostic scan.'

title: Decrypt Cipher Key 'lightborn'
subtitle: Decrypt evidence cipher in AureScanner module
loreBackground: Enter the secret cipher key 'lightborn' or '0x8891' inside AureScanner file decryption panel to unlock AETHERCORE conduit frequency codes.

steps.text: Open AureScanner decryption panel
Enter cipher key 'lightborn' and submit

dialogueHooks.briefing: Hint: 'The cipher key was discovered in intercepted DarkNet transmissions.'
dialogueHooks.completion: Evidence decrypted! AETHERCORE subterranean frequency code revealed.

title: Faith Medical Telemetry Shift
subtitle: Assist Dr. Sharon with student aura intake
loreBackground: Perform regular shift duties at Faith Medical by processing patient intake scans (.diag) and triaging student aura profiles.

steps.text: Visit faithmed.aure
Execute telemetry diagnostic scan and review Patient Log

dialogueHooks.briefing: Dr. Sharon: 'Your volunteer shift at Faith Medical is ready to begin.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Complete patient triage shift at faithmed.aure.

title: DGA Security Malware Quarantine
subtitle: Isolate rogue PRISM nodes in Sector 4
loreBackground: Rogue PRISM malware bleeds (.prism) have been detected in Sector 4. Isolate infected system processes before corrupting local gateways.

steps.text: Identify corrupted process in Process Monitor
Isolate and quarantine PRISM malware string

dialogueHooks.briefing: DGA Security: 'Rogue PRISM threads detected. Immediate quarantine required.'
dialogueHooks.progress: Isolate infected processes in Process Monitor.
